verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an MCP server (local and remote, OAuth-gated, verified live via probe) plus an agent toolkit integrating with LangChain/OpenAI Agents SDK/CrewAI/Bedrock/Vercel AI SDK, exposing natural-language-callable tools for invoices, disputes, payments, subscriptions, and merchant insights, alongside ACP/UCP agentic commerce protocols for ChatGPT/Gemini shopping — directly enabling AI-native natural-language operation. missing for 10: independent/third-party hands-on validation of the natural-language experience (beyond PayPal's own docs and a technical protocol probe), and some agentic commerce features are gated behind access requests rather than generally available.
